item.title: Grimdark roguelike Hordes of Hunger hits 1.0, infusing Megabonk's horde survival with the fundamentals of Dark Souls
item.description: Hordes of Hunger is out of early access, and its dark fantasy twist on the roguelike survival format is a weighty alternative to Megabonk.

item.title: I can't recognize my favorite League of Legends champions anymore, and I'm sick of it
item.description: Despite striving for skin clarity, Riot’s latest round of League of Legends Wild Rift splash arts barely look like the base champions.

item.title: PlayStation's underloved roguelite is cheaper than ever on PC, right before a sequel launches
item.description: Returnal is an essential game for any roguelite fans, and PlayStation’s underloved gem is now cheaper than ever, right before the sequel’s release on PS5.

item.title: Diablo 4 has been outgunned by Path of Exile 2 and Last Epoch. Lord of Hatred proves Blizzard wants to catch up.
item.description: The Diablo 4 Lord of Hatred reveal and D2R Reign of the Warlock drop show Blizzard is turning a corner and finally fixing its flaws.

item.title: Black Ops 7 is "making it right" with free handouts for all players as Mars leaderboard event racks up frustrations
item.description: Treyarch hands out free rewards to all Call of Duty Black Ops 7 players that log in during Season 2 after issues with the Mars leaderboard.

item.title: Big new World of Warcraft Midnight class tuning patch is bad news for Warriors and Mages, but makes healers more deadly
item.description: The new World of Warcraft Midnight patch notes implement a wide range of class buffs and nerfs, as Blizzard targets outliers on both sides.

item.title: Overwatch's Valentines Day dating sim Loverwatch is back for a limited time, but Blizzard's missing a trick
item.description: With Overwatch Season 1 underway, Blizzard has brought back its Valentines Day Loverwatch dating sim minigame, but it needs some new faces.

item.title: Automation builder Satisfactory is now Steam Deck Verified, becoming one of the most dangerous additions to Valve's handheld ever
item.description: If you love to build and hate having too much free time, Satisfactory is Steam Deck Verified and will burn away the hours wherever you are.

item.title: The Star Citizen free fly is back, giving you a chance to try the colossal space game as it nears a billion dollars in funding
item.description: Star Citizen’s free fly event offers five ships for you to zoom around the massive space MMO in, as its spinoff Squadron 42 nears launch.

item.title: Why you need a VPN if you're using ChatGPT or other AI chatbots
item.description: The latest ChatGPT caricatures trend has me worried about AI’s access to our private data. It’s one of the many reasons to start using a VPN.
